local_changes.sstv/sstv.hpp: Optional encoder sample rate (default unchanged at 12000 Hz), plus phase accessor for a phase-continuous output fade. Martin M2 / Scottie S2 enum values.
local_changes.sstv/encoder.cpp: Generate native 48000-Hz PCM when requested; the original 12000-Hz path is unchanged.
local_changes.sstv/timing.hpp: Add Martin M2 (VIS40, 73.216-ms scans) and Scottie S2 (VIS56, 88.064-ms scans); existing mode timings remain unchanged.
local_changes.sstv/decoder.cpp: Extend VIS and late-entry acquisition to all four modes and apply the contiguous Martin VIS-stop sync rule to M2 as well. DSP filtering/tracking is unchanged.
